WITH m AS (SELECT TO_CHAR(submitted_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS mon, SUM(total_amount) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM purchase_orders WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-08-01' AND submitted_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN mon = '2026-08' THEN amt END) AS aug_amount, MAX(CASE WHEN mon = '2026-09' THEN amt END) AS sep_amount, MAX(CASE WHEN mon = '2026-08' THEN cnt END) AS aug_count, MAX(CASE WHEN mon = '2026-09' THEN cnt END) AS sep_count, MAX(CASE WHEN mon = '2026-09' THEN amt END) - MAX(CASE WHEN mon = '2026-08' THEN amt END) AS change_amount, ROUND(CAST(((MAX(CASE WHEN mon = '2026-09' THEN amt END) - MAX(CASE WHEN mon = '2026-08' THEN amt END)) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN mon = '2026-08' THEN amt END), 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS change_percent FROM m LIMIT 100
